bio: Julie Coulon is a French performer behind the English-language Paris show Oh My God She's Parisian!, a comic look at Parisian life for visitors and locals.

name: Lorene Cadeau
bio: FFCN alumna with 'Real Life in Paris' set (1.9K+ views). French comic performing in English — instantly Paris-specific premise that lands fast with expat rooms.

name: Luke Thompson
bio: English-language stand-up comedian performing regularly at FFCN and Paris comedy rooms.

name: Maddie Storm
bio: Runs The Dissident Comedy Show (Wed 20:30) at The Dissident Club. Alternative English stand-up with a central-Paris edge.

name: Patti Mansbach
bio: FFCN alumna. Her 'Fear of Getting a French Boyfriend' set on French Fried Comedy Night has 12K+ YouTube views — a clean, crowd-forward premise that lands hard in the room.

name: Paul Taylor
bio: Paul Taylor is a British comedian in France. His official site says he created, wrote and starred in WTF France and built a large audience with French-culture comedy; his current official homepage spotlights F*** me I’m French!, a 100% English show.

name: Randy J Dreams
bio: Runs MANGO English Stand-Up at Le Paris de l'Humour Wed 19:45. English-language MC with regular Eventbrite shows.

name: Robert le Ricain
bio: American comedian and one of the early builders of the Paris English-language comedy scene. Launched French Fried Comedy Night in 2013 at Paname Art Cafe, helped give Paul Taylor one of his first regular stages, and produced/directed 'La Bise' — the viral video that helped map the scene. Now runs FFCN at Velvet Bar Wednesdays.

name: Sarah Donnelly
bio: Sarah Donnelly is an American comedian, screenwriter, podcaster and actress living in Paris. Her official site says she performs across the U.S., Europe and Asia, has opened for Jerry Seinfeld, toured with Gad Elmaleh and released The Only American in Paris on YouTube.

name: Sebastian Marx
bio: Sebastian Marx is an American stand-up comedian living in Paris. His official site describes him as an American humorist in France, currently in Paris and on tour.

name: Tamer Kattan
bio: New York comedian who made Paris his second home. 159K+ followers on social media. Regular collaborator with Robert le Ricain and a favorite on the Paris English-language circuit.

name: Tania Dutel
bio: French comedian who performs brilliantly in both French and English. Known for sharp observational humor and fearless stage presence. A regular at English-language shows in Paris and proof of how international the scene has become.
